contracts: Valid replacement cache becomes visible atomically; serialization, sync or replacement failure preserves the prior file.
Malformed cached or provider metadata must not become a partial in-memory catalogue or destroy the last good file.
One cooperating CLI per collection directory holds an operating-system lock before checkpoint reads until exit.
Windows launcher keeps stdin interactive and installs only the repository requirements.
limits: Local CLI source release; existing records are not accessed or migrated by fixtures. Catalog completeness and Supabase migration remain separate.

local_validation.skip_reason: Windows host lacks symbolic-link creation; hosted Linux and Windows must cover supported cases.
